game_title: Branching Tale – Pearl Divers' Lagoon Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Coastal Port – Pearl Divers' Lagoon, a lagoon of pearl divers: the dock cartographer must handle rogue crabs while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Branching Tale: Make story choices that run different if/elif branches toward different endings.
theme: Coastal Port – Pearl Divers' Lagoon: a lagoon of pearl divers
core_gameplay_loop: In Pearl Divers' Lagoon, repeat each round: Make story choices that run different if/elif branches toward different endings. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the story_trust value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the signal flag using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The signal flag reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the signal flag is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 10 (extended tier): Branching Tale
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Branching Tale' (Week 3 slot 12), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Pearl Divers' Lagoon'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how story_trust changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crabs in Pearl Divers' Lagoon.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The signal flag reached with actions_used <= 15.
